hypothesis: For the 13 hash-pinned decision frames and 12 consecutive pairs from retained Astra MAP01 attempt v1, a CUDA implementation of the frozen one-way health ROI changed-pixel metric will return exactly the same changed-pixel counts and INVALIDATED/UNCHANGED classifications as an independent CPU implementation. This checks whether GPU acceleration can safely support frequent observable-evidence guard sampling; it does not test live timing, combat efficacy, or a new guard policy.
matrix: per-pixel maximum absolute channel difference > 32 counts as changed; ROI pixels 95x50 RGB
metrics: per-pair exact changed-pixel count and status parity CPU vs CUDA
correctness first; throughput and peak CUDA allocation descriptive only
stop_rules: CUDA unavailable or frame/hash/geometry mismatch => STOP before comparison
any CPU/GPU exact-count or status mismatch => FAIL_GPU_CPU_PARITY; do not tune threshold or rerun
any divergence from retained manual audit => FAIL_RETAINED_LABEL_PARITY; retain all counts
no live control, no Doom process, no model inference, no Docker, no source policy modification
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Laptop GPU, CUDA torch runtime, shared desktop GPU; short bounded offline job
data_limit: single failed MAP01 run, 13 selected decision frames, 12 paired transitions; decision frames were selected after the run and labels are manually transcribed
